stories.title: “Başına neler gelecek” demişti... Fatih Belediye Başkanı’ndan Arınç’a olay sözler

en.title: "What will happen to you" he said... Fatih Mayor's controversial words to Arınç
en.summary: Fatih Mayor Mehmet Ergün Turan made controversial remarks directed at Bülent Arınç during a wedding ceremony for Ahmet Davutoğlu's son.

stories.title: Silivri'de batan geminin mürettebatı için acılı bekleyiş... Arama çalışmaları 13'üncü gününde

en.title: Painful waiting for crew of sunken ship in Silivri... Search operations on 13th day
en.summary: A 10-member crew remains missing following the sinking of the Tuğberk İmamoğlu vessel after a collision with the Alsu ship off Silivri, with search efforts continuing into their second week.

stories.title: Fatih Belediye Başkanı Ergün Turan'dan Bülent Arınç'a 'nikah' tepkisi

en.title: Fatih Mayor Ergün Turan responds to Bülent Arınç over wedding remarks
en.summary: Fatih Mayor Mehmet Ergün Turan criticized Bülent Arınç's conduct at a wedding ceremony, stating that making political comments at weddings and funerals is disrespectful and contrary to social values.

stories.title: Amasya'da çöp ev alarmı: İhbar üzerine giden ekipler 1 ton atık çıkardı

en.title: Hoarding alarm in Amasya: Teams removed 1 ton of waste following report
en.summary: Authorities in Amasya discovered a three-story house converted into a waste storage area after responding to complaints of foul odors and removed approximately one ton of debris.

stories.title: Bursa'da kan donduran görüntüler: Kucağındaki kediye acımasızca şiddet uyguladı

en.title: Shocking scenes in Bursa: He brutally abused the cat in his lap
en.summary: A man in Bursa's Osmangazi district allegedly under the influence of alcohol physically attacked a cat he was holding and threw it to the ground.

stories.title: İhbar üzerine kapıyı açan ekipler gözlerine inanamadı: Evden 1 ton çöp çıktı

en.title: Teams who opened the door upon report could not believe their eyes: 1 ton of garbage removed from house
en.summary: Authorities responding to reports of a strong odor in Amasya discovered large piles of garbage inside a three-story residential building.

stories.title: Kucağındaki kediye şiddet uyguladığı anlar kamerada

en.title: Moments captured on camera of violence against cat in his lap
en.summary: Security camera footage in Bursa recorded a man physically abusing a cat he was holding, striking its head against the ground.

stories.title: Silivri’de batan gemideki mürettebatı arama çalışmalarında 13. gün

en.title: 13th day of search efforts for crew of sunken ship in Silivri
en.summary: Search operations for 10 crew members aboard the vessel Tuğberk İmamoğlu, which sank off Silivri after colliding with ship Alsu, entered its 13th day.

stories.title: İkizler çetesine 2. dalga operasyon: Avukat ve iş insanlarının da bulunduğu 12 kişi gözaltında

en.title: Second wave operation against Twins gang: 12 people detained including lawyer and businessmen
en.summary: A second wave operation was conducted in an investigation targeting the Twins criminal organization based in Kocaeli, resulting in the detention of 12 suspects including a lawyer and businessmen.

stories.title: 'İkizler' suç örgütüne 2. dalga operasyon: Aralarında avukat ve iş insanlarının da bulunduğu 12 kişi gözaltında!

en.title: Second wave operation against Twins criminal organization: 12 suspects detained including lawyer and businessmen
en.summary: Twelve suspects including a lawyer and businessmen were detained in a second wave operation against the Twins criminal organization based in Kocaeli. Fourteen people had previously been arrested in the investigation.

stories.title: Adana'da dehşete düşüren görüntüler! Tartıştığı kadını sopayla öldüresiye darp etti: Saçlarından tutup…

en.title: Horrifying scenes in Adana! Man brutally beat woman he argued with using a stick: Dragging her by hair...
en.summary: A man in Adana violently beat a woman with whom he was arguing on a balcony using a stick, with neighbors recording the incident on their mobile phones.

stories.title: Adana'da erkek şiddeti: Kadını sopayla dövdü, saçından sürükledi!

en.title: Male violence in Adana: Beat woman with stick, dragged her by hair
en.summary: A man in Adana's Sarıçam district beat a woman with a stick for several minutes during an argument on a balcony, then dragged her by her hair into a room.

stories.title: Pistten çıkan özel jet alevler içinde kaldı

en.title: Private jet catches fire after leaving runway
en.summary: A private jet veered off the runway during landing at Misrata International Airport in Libya and caught fire. Airport operations were halted following the incident, though no information has been provided regarding crew and passenger status.

stories.title: Denizcilik işlemlerinde yeni dönem: Bankaya gitme devri kapanıyor

en.title: New era in maritime operations: End of bank visits
en.summary: Maritime payment operations are increasingly digitalized, with approximately 80 percent of payments now processed online via credit card. The system will be expanded to cover all fees and payments, eliminating the need for in-person bank visits.

stories.title: Güneş paneli fiyatları düştü elektrik şirketlerinde gelir baskısı başladı

en.title: Solar panel prices fall, creating revenue pressure for electricity companies
en.summary: Solar panel prices have dropped to approximately 12 cents per watt due to large-scale Chinese manufacturing. Households and businesses are increasingly generating their own electricity, reducing demand from distribution networks facing revenue losses and growing infrastructure costs.

stories.title: Uçak biletlerinde indirim fırsatı: Koltuk seçimi de 99 TL

en.title: Discount opportunity on plane tickets: Seat selection also 99 TL
en.summary: AJet announced a discount campaign covering domestic flights with 30 percent off ticket prices and standard seat selection available for 99 TL. The discounted tickets are available for purchase until September 15 at 23:59.

stories.title: TOKİ KİRALIK SOSYAL KONUT BAŞVURU EKRANI... TOKİ kiralık konut başvurusu nasıl yapılır, şartlar neler?

en.title: TOKI Rental Social Housing Application Screen... How to Apply for TOKI Rental Housing, What Are the Requirements?
en.summary: Turkey's Ministry of Environment, Urbanization and Climate Change launched a rental housing project across multiple Istanbul districts. Applications began today for residents seeking to participate in the program.
